text: In the 2024/2025 insurance period, 3,664 individuals enrolled with $2.47 million in protection, over FJ$107,000 in payouts delivered, and 87% of prior payout recipients restarted income-generating activities. The scale-up target is to cover at least 5,000 households (~25,000 people) and include at least 2,000 social welfare recipients.
